items.title: Anonymous POST create item is 401
items.reason: Core of the bug: anonymous create returned 201, letting anyone add products. Functional layer because it needs the real API pipeline and auth middleware.

items.title: Anonymous PUT v2 update item is 401

items.title: Anonymous PUT v1 update item is 401
covers: Technical Notes: UpdateItemV1 mapped without RequireAuthorization
items.reason: The v1 update is a separate route (`UpdateItemV1`) that could be missed when securing v2; a gap would leave a bypass.

items.title: Anonymous DELETE item is 401
items.reason: Anonymous delete returned 204, so anyone could remove products. Separate endpoint registration (`DeleteItemById`).

items.title: Rejected anonymous writes leave the catalog unchanged
covers: Actual: anyone can change products and prices
items.reason: Guards against auth that runs after the handler (status 401 but data still changed, price event still published). Checks persisted state across all three write verbs together.
